wallet_ledger_lot_shape.name: wallet_ledger_lot_shape
wallet_ledger_lot_shape.value: ("wallet_ledger"."amount_kopecks" > 0) = ("wallet_ledger"."lot_remaining_kopecks" IS NOT NULL AND "wallet_ledger"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

wallet_certificates_activation_shape.name: wallet_certificates_activation_shape
wallet_certificates_activation_shape.value: ("wallet_certificates"."status" = 'activated') = ("wallet_certificates"."activated_by_customer" IS NOT NULL AND "wallet_certificates"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL)

leads_requests_contact.name: leads_requests_contact
leads_requests_contact.value: "leads_requests"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "leads_requests"."phone" IS NOT NULL
